verdict.rationale: GDScript is documented as Godot's built-in, gradually-typed, object-oriented scripting language designed for the engine's own API (godot-docs-1, godot-docs-8), and it can drive the full editor/plugin system (godot-docs-4, godot-docs-13). However, the evidence pack has no explicit documentation of a debugger front-end, and community feedback raises real productivity concerns about GDScript itself (missing language features like list comprehensions/tuples/first-class functions, poor docs experience) (godot-comm-13, godot-comm-15), which tempers the 'productive' claim without constituting a concrete failure of API coverage. missing for 10: explicit debugger documentation/evidence, independent confirmation that GDScript fully exposes 100% of engine API without gaps, resolution of community complaints about language ergonomics.
